name: agent-trust-sdk
description: AgenticTrust workspace: @trustflow/sdk, @trustflow/cli, @trustflow/mcp-server, @trustflow/next-plugin, @trustflow/vercel-plugin, framework middleware, and Next.js starters. Hosted registry: Trustflow Systems.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @trustflow/sdk build && pnpm --filter @trustflow/cli build && pnpm --filter @trustflow/mcp-server build && pnpm --filter @trustflow/next-plugin build && pnpm --filter @trustflow/langchain-middleware build && pnpm --filter @trustflow/vercel-ai-middleware build && pnpm --filter @trustflow/vercel-plugin build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @trustflow/sdk build && pnpm --filter @trustflow/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @trustflow/mcp-server typecheck && pnpm --filter @trustflow/next-plugin typecheck && pnpm --filter @trustflow/langchain-middleware typecheck && pnpm --filter @trustflow/vercel-ai-middleware typecheck && pnpm --filter @trustflow/vercel-plugin typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @trustflow/sdk test && pnpm --filter @trustflow/cli test && pnpm --filter @trustflow/mcp-server test && pnpm --filter @trustflow/next-plugin test && pnpm --filter @trustflow/langchain-middleware test && pnpm --filter @trustflow/vercel-ai-middleware test && pnpm --filter @trustflow/vercel-plugin test && node --test scripts/create-starter-prs.test.mjs scripts/submit-ecosystem-prs.test.mjs scripts/notify-verified-domain.test.mjs scripts/launch-readiness.test.mjs
scripts.smoke: pnpm --filter @trustflow/sdk build && pnpm --filter @trustflow/cli build && pnpm --filter @trustflow/cli smoke
